ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution exceeding 90% of the fluke surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters and linear formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity white punctate spots across both lobes; a dense cluster of diagonal linear white streaks on the left lobe; concentrated white scarring at the insertion point of the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 60 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with prominent peaks and valleys; a distinct, large irregular indentation is visible on the distal section of the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curve extending from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve leading to the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle attachment scars, located primarily on the medial and lower central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions; a notable series of parallel diagonal scratches (rake marks) is concentrated on the left lateral lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive multi-directional rake marks and circular depigmented lesions across the ventral surface of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged morphology on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, characterized by a significant missing portion or deep indentation.
